court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
case_name: Nanda Pramod @ Deepak Sonwane vs Pramod @ Deepak Karbhari Sonwane

parties.respondent_defendant: Nanda w/o Promod @ Deepak Sonwane, wife

acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: Petitioner/husband filed petition for divorce under Section 13(1)(ia) and (ib) of the Hindu Marriage Act on ground of cruelty and desertion. Parties were married in 2002, had two daughters. Compromise took place in 2004, but they lived separate from each other since 2008.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party alleging cruelty to prove the same.
legal_principles.held: Accordingly, it is held that the petitioner / husband failed to prove the allegation of cruelty.

legal_principles.principle: A party's willingness to cohabit does not necessarily mean they have not deserted their spouse.
legal_principles.held: However, as the father of her husband is retired Police Officer, at his instance her husband subjected her to physical and mental cruelty.
applicable_acts_sections: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

outcome.final_order: Decree for divorce passed by the trial court was set aside and appeal was allowed.

keywords: Protection of Women from DV Act
